gpu_bench_sum_header: Renderer | Tiles | Result | Backend·MSAA | Load | Init | Scene | Compile | First draw | First frame | Ready total (excl. load) | fps | p50 | p95 | Max | Over 50ms | CPU p50 | CPU p95 | GPU p50 | GPU p95 | GPU done/s | GPU pending | Draws | Triangles | Heap MB | JS KB (sent/raw) | Note
gpu_bench_sum_footnote: Times are in ms. Rows are in run order (the renderer order shifts by one for each tile count). fps, p50 and p95 = frame interval. CPU = time inside render(). Compile = shaders and pipelines per material (WebGL includes the link check). First draw includes uploading every tile buffer. Ready total = init + scene + compile + first frame. GPU p50 and p95 = from submit until the frame start where the finished work is seen, so both APIs round up to whole frame intervals. Compare APIs by GPU done/s (below fps means the GPU fell behind). Notes: first_use = first time this page started that API (init includes one-time start-up), no_msaa = WebGPU compatibility mode turned MSAA off (do not compare directly with ×4 rows).

holdings_packed_note: Packed food keeps its freshness. Unpack it to get a single item that starts to spoil.
holdings_error_not_packed: This is not packed food, so it can't be unpacked.
cyborg_rebirth_changes_body: Your level goes back to 1 and experience to 0 (no experience boost). You can keep your stat spread, or pick a temperament and reroll it as at creation ({rerolls} rerolls, no manual allocation). Growth is always rerolled, even if you keep your spread. You can keep or re-split your 10 basic element points. Faith resets to 0.
cyborg_rebirth_keeps_body: Artificial organs stay installed. Skill slots and max skill grade gained from earlier rebirths stay too.
cyborg_rebirth_gains_body: +1 skill slot, +1 max skill grade and a free change of look. Using a path religious item also gives light or dark element points, or that religion's special skill.
cyborg_rebirth_currency_value: {amount} · currency of the city with the rebirth facility
cyborg_rebirth_items_value: Optional: use one to open the light or dark branch, or to get that religion's special skill (not needed for a basic rebirth)
cyborg_rebirth_place: Rebirth takes place at a rebirth facility (temple). The body swap at your home port is a cutscene.
cyborg_rebirth_k: A rebirth facility shows your growth rate (K).
cyborg_ranking_later: Rankings for the paths you take part in show here.
cyborg_ranking_note: Each path is ranked separately. Timed buffs don't count.
ranking_measure_battle_wins: Battle wins incl. wave defence (vs. enemy strength)
ranking_faction_measures: Cities, development, humans and treasury (size at tally)
ranking_me_none: No score on this board yet.
ranking_me_no_faction: Your faction isn't on this board.
ranking_renown_note: Faction renown comes from repelling gardener waves. It isn't added to the score.
ranking_empty: Nobody has scored on this board yet.
ranking_unknown: No such path. Pick another board.
ranking_pending: Waiting for the first tally. The server counts within minutes of starting.
ranking_rules_note: Scores shrink {decay}% each tally, so stay active to keep them. Timed buffs don't count.
ranking_preview_notice: These rankings are filled with test data.
cyborg_core_note_max: Tap a bar (or hover with a mouse) to see where the total comes from. At max level your growth rate (K) and starting values are shown. Rebirth rerolls K.
cyborg_core_note: Tap a bar (or hover with a mouse) to see where the total comes from. Growth rate (K) shows at max level, at a rebirth facility and at a biotech facility.
cyborg_attack_formula: Stat attack + weapon attack × min(1, {stat} ÷ required)
cyborg_stamina_real_formula: Actual regen = row value × min(2, STA score ÷ appropriate STA)
cyborg_buff_legend: Pill = share from active effects (buffs and debuffs). In battle = base + share
cyborg_elements_note: Element values (0–10 per cell) come from creation (split 10 points over up to two of water, fire, wind and earth), rebirth (keep or re-split; a religious rebirth picks light or dark), organs, gear and faith. Each cell stops at 10.
cyborg_footer_time: Computed by the server from saved values · as of {time}
dev_tool_second_map_desc: Open any local map without units and change the time, place, height exaggeration and grid (view only, game state never changes).
second_map_lab_view_label: Local map lab view. Drag with one finger to move, use two fingers to zoom and rotate. Tap to see that cell's values.
second_map_lab_error_none: This planet has no place like that.
second_map_lab_error_bad_key: That isn't a local map key on this planet (different face level or outside the face).
second_map_lab_error_not_ready: The server is still preparing terrain. Try again shortly.
second_map_lab_error_forbidden: You don't have permission to use this screen.
second_map_lab_build_ask: This builds the planet (F{level}) on this device for the first time. It takes about 15 s on a desktop and uses a lot of worker memory. Phone time and memory are unknown.
second_map_lab_sky_off_hint: With day and night off, the map uses the same fixed daylight.
second_map_lab_exaggeration_hint: Game heights are 1/12 of real heights; ×12 is the real ratio. Only the view changes, the terrain data stays the same.
second_map_lab_exaggeration_cap: This map's height range only allows up to ×{max}.
second_map_lab_prop_span: Tree and rock models when the view is under {m} m
second_map_lab_cell_hint: Tap the map to see that cell's values.
second_map_lab_planet_cell: This map's planet cell F{level} (one local map is one planet cell)
map_dark_explain: This account has no units and nothing explored, so the local map is dark. Areas light up where your units go.
map_dark_dev: Press [{spawn}] to get workers or turn on [{observe}] to see it. Change the time, place and relief in the Local map lab in the developer area.
economy_preview_notice: You're viewing sample data. Order and production buttons won't send commands.
economy_preview_hint: Turn on sample data in Home → Edit to try a sample exchange.
economy_not_ready_market: The exchange isn't open yet. Once it opens, you can buy and sell goods in every city.
economy_not_ready_production: You don't own any production facilities yet. Once you do, schedule production here.
economy_not_ready_exchange: The exchange opens when the city economy is running. It then collects orders and clears them together at set times.
economy_not_ready_orders: Your orders will appear here once the exchange opens.
economy_capacity_unit_note: Capacity counts trade lots for now (1 kg lots for ore, single items otherwise). The final unit is weight (kg), so it switches to kg once item weights are set.
economy_worker_formula: Speed = max(1, ⌊{primary} ÷ {divisor}⌋) · per harvest {base} + ⌊{secondary} × {rate}⌋, up to {cap}
economy_worker_harvest: Per harvest T0 {t0} · T1 {t1} · T2 {t2} · T3 {t3}
economy_lot_note: Prices and quantities are per lot ({size}).
economy_no_owner: You don't own anything in this world yet. Put units to work and their output will pile up here.
economy_wage_formula: Wage = efficiency × rate (city base rate + your adjustment)
labor_rules: Wage: deposit = wage × {days} days, warning when less than {warn} days are left, automatic firing when it runs out, paused when one wage is not covered. Lease: hourly rent; unpaid rent, the end of the term or ending it by either side starts a grace period of {grace} to collect leftover goods.
labor_not_ready: The world is starting up, so contracts are not available yet.
labor_end_deposit_used_up: The deposit ran out, so the worker was fired.
labor_end_rent_unpaid: Ended because the rent was not paid.
labor_end_unit_gone: Ended because the unit is gone.
labor_end_building_gone: Ended because the facility is gone.
labor_field_term: Term (hours, leave empty for no term)
labor_units_other_map: Free units on other second maps ({count}) can't work at this facility and are left out.
labor_rent_title: Rent for my facilities (hourly, 0 = not for lease)
labor_error_busy: The server is busy. Try again shortly.
labor_error_rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
labor_error_forbidden: That facility, unit or contract is not yours.
labor_error_unit_busy: That unit already has a contract.
labor_error_invalid_terms: Those terms are outside the rules.
labor_error_not_for_lease: That facility is not for lease.
labor_error_not_open: That contract has ended or is in its grace period.
labor_error_offline: Connection lost. Check the list again.
labor_error_timeout: No answer. Check the list again.
labor_error_job_not_open: That job is gone or already closed.
labor_error_employer_insufficient_funds: The facility owner cannot cover the deposit.
labor_error_not_workplace: That facility is not a workplace (not a gathering facility, or still being built).
labor_error_facility_full: All worker slots at that facility are taken.
labor_error_not_assigned: That unit is not assigned to a job.
labor_error_wrong_map: That unit is not on the same second map as the facility. Only units on that map can work there.
labor_grace_note: During the grace period the tenant can take out their share from the facility storage. When it ends, the goods left there pass to the facility owner.
labor_leftovers_moved: The grace period ended and the goods left in the facility storage passed to the facility owner.
labor_terminate_grace_hint: A lease ends after a {grace} grace period.
labor_jobs_hint: Take a job at someone else's facility with your unit to start a wage contract. The facility owner pays the deposit and the wage goes to your wallet.
labor_jobs_rate_note: Until city labor markets exist, the base rate applies and every unit counts as a standard unit.
labor_job_other_map: Not on the chosen unit's second map
labor_post_hint: One posting per facility; posting again replaces it. The deposit leaves your wallet when someone takes the job.
labor_post_preview: Standard unit wage {wage} / {cycle} · deposit {deposit} per hire
economy_recipe_time_from: From {time} with one standard worker (all T0)
economy_market_auction_note: Finished goods like equipment trade in auction listings (coming soon). Gems of the same type, tier and grade are interchangeable, so they trade on the order book.
economy_market_items_hint: Pick an item to compare prices across cities.
economy_cities_hint: Cities out of sight show the last prices you saw. Goods bought where you have no storage stay there until you ship them.
economy_chart_label: {item} in {city}: 30-minute candles over 24 hours, high {high}, low {low}
economy_book_observed: This city is out of sight. Prices as seen {time}.
economy_sum_unfilled: {qty} won't fill within your price limit
economy_sum_conditional: Places a limit order when triggered. Funds are held at that point.
economy_sum_tax_note: The seller pays the sales tax.
economy_limit_help: Assign units with higher INT and WIS to the exchange to raise your order limit.
economy_limit_reached_at: Order limit reached. You can order again at {time}.
economy_submit_hint: The exchange isn't open yet, so orders can't be sent. The figures above are a preview.
economy_no_warehouse: You have no storage in this city. Goods you buy stay here until you ship them.
economy_exchange_intro: Currencies trade against the base currency ({base}). Orders are collected and matched together at one price on a schedule.
economy_placeholder_pack: Placeholder content pack. Items and values aren't game design.
screen_soon_section: Opening soon. Real data will show here once the rules are ready.
screen_soon_pressed: This opens soon. No command was sent.
screen_preview_switch_hint: Dev and admin only. Same switch as Home.
faction_preview_notice: You're viewing sample data. It isn't a real faction, and buttons won't send commands.
faction_none_body: Found a family or join a faction to see its details here.
faction_rule_leader: The ruling family's head decides alone. There are no votes.
faction_rule_per_family: Each member family casts one vote.
faction_rule_by_shares: Votes are weighted by the city shares you hold.
faction_me_no_owner: You have no world record yet. It's created when you enter the map.
faction_locks_hint: Each opens once its conditions are met.
faction_city_threshold: Rebellion at {value} or less · warning at {warning}
faction_dip_scores_hint: Relation (favor) differs for each pair of factions. Faction trust is one value per faction that everyone sees, and it drops when a treaty is broken.
faction_treaty_offers_hint_vote: Alliance, protectorate, territory transfer, ceasefire and peace go to a vote. Ceasefire and peace votes are short. The leader signs the other treaties directly.
faction_treaty_offers_hint_leader: Under a dictatorship, the head of the ruling family signs every treaty directly.
faction_war_declare_hint: Declaring without a cause badly hurts relations with every faction and costs treasury funds.
faction_war_deadline_rule: If no time is picked within 24 hours of the siege declaration, the siege opens at this time.
faction_dividend_rule: Dividends come from city tax: issue interest is burned first, then city running costs are paid, and the remaining profit is split every {period}: by shares under capitalism, by shares under dictatorship with the treasury's part going to the ruling family, and all kept in the treasury under democracy.
faction_share_dividend_treasury: No dividend (remaining profit goes to the treasury)
faction_share_dividend_ruling: The treasury's part goes to the ruling family
faction_path_share_vote: The top-holding family opens a vote. It passes with 50%+ of shares, or is declared outright by a family holding 50% alone.
faction_path_family_vote: One vote per family in the city; a majority means independence.
faction_path_rebellion_only: There's no independence vote; only a rebellion breaks away.
faction_path_none_start_city: Start cities have no independence vote.
faction_occ_offer_hint: Accept to keep your building shares and join the occupier. Refuse or let it expire and you lose your assets there, get driven out and become hostile to the occupier, a target for attack.
faction_occ_restoration_hint: Anyone can contribute, and contributions become shares of this city in proportion ({count} per city).
faction_occ_restoration_mine: You gave {amount} {currency} · about {shares} shares once the goal is met
faction_occ_outcome_loot: Treasury share taken {amount} {currency} · the city keeps its owner
faction_occ_outcome_occupy_ended: Taxes collected {amount} {currency} · the occupation has ended
faction_occ_outcome_integrate: Rebuild cost {amount} {currency} · slow morale recovery ends {time}
faction_occ_outcome_integrate_ended: Rebuild cost {amount} {currency} · slow recovery has ended
mail_preview_notice: You're viewing sample data. Send and claim buttons won't send commands.
mail_empty_inbox_hint: Items or faction currency that other cyborgs send you arrive here. Rewards and notices come as to-dos, not mail.
mail_recipient_hint: Cyborg names are unique on the server, so the name alone is enough.
mail_attach_hint: Units, Terra Coins and account-bound items can't be sent. Up to {count} attachments.
mail_attach_none: You don't have any items or faction currency to send yet.
mail_send_soon: Everything checks out. Sending opens soon — nothing was sent.
mail_err_text_invalid: Contains characters that can't be used.
dev_tool_tuning_desc: See the planning setting cells (49), change them live in this world and export the changes as a pack diff
dev_tuning_lead: Changes apply to this world right away (the pack stays as is). [Apply] checks and changes every staged cell at once.
dev_tuning_page_all_lead: Every cell, grouped by design code. Pick an area tab above to see only that area's cells.
dev_tuning_page_society_lead: Occupation and loot shares, satisfaction targets and recovery, incorporation deadline, rebellion thresholds, lifespan, tech levels and development, fatigue, wages, recruit cards, temples, ruin restoration.
dev_tuning_page_npc_lead: NPC trait axes, decision interval, tax rules, decision score weights, world seed (start cities, base facilities, day and night work).
dev_tuning_page_gardener_lead: How cell pollution grows, fades and spreads; wave chance, strength and warning; nomad bands; gardener relations; travel raids.
dev_tuning_page_holdings_lead: Gear wear, repair loss, ammo refill loss, potion and food cooldowns, auto-potion threshold, spoil speed per storage place.
dev_tuning_page_combat_lead: Battle time limits, retreat, bush and height sight, element affinity, evasion, crits and stamina, life regen, injury stages and hospitals.
dev_tuning_page_economy_lead: Gathering tiers and progress, raw-material objects, building construction and ageing, labour contracts, NPC central bank.
dev_tuning_page_other_lead: Cyborg creation, growth, rebirth and grants; fusion and genes; rankings; territory; operator switches.
dev_tuning_scope_live_hint: The server uses it from the next request
dev_tuning_scope_sim_hint: The server does not read it yet. Only the simulator and exports use it
dev_tuning_reloaded: Someone changed values first, so the list was reloaded. Check the staged changes and apply again.
dev_tuning_err_unknown_entry: That cell is not in the pack.
dev_tuning_err_out_of_range: A value is outside its technical range.
dev_tuning_err_invalid_note: Notes are up to 200 characters with no hidden characters.
dev_tuning_err_duplicate_entry: The same cell was staged twice.
dev_tuning_err_rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
dev_tuning_err_forbidden: This account cannot manage setting cells.
dev_tuning_err_unavailable: This server has no tuning panel (no database or sign-in).
dev_tuning_problem_n9_fit: N9: the stat sum must be between min × 6 and max × 6
dev_tuning_problem_n36_fit: N36: 1 to 4 element cells, points ≤ cells × 10
dev_tuning_problem_fatigue_order: N21·N23: fatigue band starts rise and stay at or below the maximum
dev_tuning_problem_food_order: N33: food zero threshold ≤ low threshold
dev_tuning_problem_n45_fit: N45: recruit cards per level — card count and total stats min ≤ max (at most 16 cards, total at least 6), 1–4 elements, element points fit the element count (1–10 per element)
dev_tuning_confirm_structural_body: {count} staged cells are structural values set by decisions (D-5054). Apply them anyway?
dev_tuning_confirm_revert_all_body: Return {count} changed cells to their pack values. This is recorded in the audit log.
dev_tuning_export_body: {count} cells. Put them into the pack with pnpm tuning:apply <file>, which bumps the pack version.
dev_tuning_copy_failed: Could not copy. Copy it from the text box.
dev_tuning_history_dropped: Removed (does not fit the new pack)
dev_tuning_cells_summary: {total} cells in 49 · {connected} wired · {noValue} without a value · {notConnected} not wired
dev_tuning_cells_note: A read-only list built from the planning document 49. Names are the Korean names from 49.
dev_tuning_problem_stat_primary_unused: Stat weights: a primary stat would have zero weight in every row (a worthless primary)
dev_tool_balance_desc: Build team A and B parties, set unit stats, elements, gear and skills (save presets), and fight single battles or Monte Carlo runs. The weight table tab shows +10 contributions
dev_balance_lead: Compare what +10 in each primary stat does under the current table and your edited table. The server computes everything; [Apply] puts your edits into this world right away (the pack stays as is).
dev_balance_fighter_hint: Starts from an average new cyborg (all primaries 10, unarmed). Win rates pit this fighter with one primary +10 against this fighter.
dev_balance_budget: Runs × time limit must be at most {max} s (now {value} s).
dev_balance_primary_invalid: Primary stats are whole numbers from {min} to {max}.
dev_balance_table_hint: Weights are in ‰ (1000 = 1 per primary point). Probability rows approach the cap (‰) with the half constant. Editing a cell stages it; scroll the table sideways.
dev_balance_legend_formula: Formula row: weight cells have no effect
dev_balance_formula_hint: This row is computed by its expression in the Formulas tab. Editing its weight cells does not change the value.
dev_balance_contrib_hint: Each cell is how much the secondary stat changes when that primary goes up by 10. If your edits change it, it shows 'now → edited'.
dev_balance_worthless_none: Every primary changes some secondary stat
dev_balance_duels_hint: Seeded duels, half in each side order, merged. Timeouts are judged by remaining HP share; ties count as half. 50% is the baseline (identical fighters). Remaining share is the average gap in remaining (HP + armor + shield) share at the end, so it shows how far ahead +10 is even when it always wins.
dev_balance_duels_stale: The base fighter or staged cells changed. Run again to see new numbers.
dev_balance_weak: Weak primaries (+10 does not beat the base): {stats}
dev_balance_weak_none: Every primary at +10 beats the base more often
dev_balance_reloaded: Someone changed the settings first, so the table was reloaded. Your staged cells are kept.
dev_balance_err_invalid_settings: Duel settings are out of bounds (runs × time limit ≤ 2400 s).
dev_balance_err_unknown_weapon: That weapon is not in this world. Reload the table.
dev_balance_err_busy: Another duel run is in progress. Try again shortly.
dev_balance_err_timeout: The duel run took too long and was stopped. Use fewer runs or a shorter time limit.
dev_balance_err_unknown_entry: That cell is not in the table.
dev_balance_err_out_of_range: A value is out of the cell's range.
dev_balance_err_duplicate_entry: The same cell is staged twice.
dev_balance_err_invalid_note: The note cannot be saved (200 characters or fewer, no control characters).
dev_balance_err_rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
dev_balance_err_forbidden: You do not have permission to use this screen.
dev_balance_err_unavailable: The balance screen is not available on this server.
dev_tool_skills_desc: Edit every skill field and special effect, and set stamina/MP cost per action. Applies to this world at once
dev_tool_items_desc: Edit every field and class of each item, check server-computed previews, then apply what you staged at once. Applies to this world right away
dev_tool_buildings_desc: Edit each facility's construction materials by level band, slots and gathering, applied to this world right away
dev_tool_territory_desc: See city–beacon convex hulls, overlap rules and the primary-map cell layer, and place beacons for test factions
dev_skills_lead: Saved changes apply to this world at once (the pack stays as is; [Export] puts them into the pack). The server checks every field with the pack validator.
dev_skills_export_hint: Setting, weight, skill and weapon overrides go into one file. Put it into the pack with pnpm tuning:apply <file>.
dev_skills_new_id_invalid: An ID starts with a lowercase letter and has 2–48 lowercase letters, digits or _.
dev_skills_new_id_taken: That ID exists or was used and removed before.
dev_skills_pick: Pick a skill from the list.
dev_skills_bare_hand_hint: Only bare-hand skills work without a weapon. They always use the unit kind's natural weapon (physical) or natural elemental data (elemental) (D-490).
dev_skills_weapon_field_hint: The held weapon must have this field. Damage skills need the same field as the base.
dev_skills_reverted: {id} is back to the pack value
dev_skills_reloaded: Someone changed it first, so the list was reloaded. Your edits are kept.
dev_skills_err_unknown_entry: The entry is not in the pack.
dev_skills_err_retired_id: An ID used and removed before can't be reused.
dev_skills_err_duplicate_entry: The same entry is twice in one batch.
dev_skills_err_invalid_note: The note has characters that can't be stored or is over 200 characters.
dev_skills_err_rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
dev_skills_err_unavailable: This server has no skill editor.
dev_skills_confirm_delete: Delete the created skill {id} from this world?
dev_skills_confirm_revert: Remove the override of {id} and go back to the pack value?
dev_skills_cond_appropriate_met: STR or INT at or above the weapon's appropriate
dev_skills_costs_lead: Every action except walking costs stamina (D-418). These are base values; actual cost = value × max(minimum, appropriate STA ÷ STA score), where appropriate STA follows level (D-511). [Apply] takes effect at once.
dev_skills_basis_lead: A unit whose primaries all start at 10 and grow with level (D-511 appropriate-stat concept). Appropriate STA = formula stamina_appropriate (by level); actual regen = secondary stamina regen × min(2, STA score ÷ appropriate STA) (formula real_stamina_regen). If a cost per second below is higher than regen, basic attacks stall. Tune the values here, on the formula tab and in the weight table.
dev_skills_mp_basic_hint: MP is spent only when the basic attack field is elemental
dev_skills_err_entry_changed: Someone changed the same skill first.
dev_skills_rebased: {id}: your changed fields were put back on top of the new value. Check them and save again.
dev_skills_rebase_conflicts: Fields changed on both sides (your value kept): {fields}
dev_items_lead: Edits go into staged changes and [Apply] sends them as one batch. The server checks them with the pack validator, then applies them to this world.
dev_items_export_hint: Put this file into the pack with pnpm tuning:apply and commit it (same file as settings and skills).
dev_items_sleep_id_collision: same ID now in the pack
dev_items_fx_lead: Effects shared by skills and items (D-425). Applied changes reach the next combat data.
dev_items_fx_pick: Pick an effect in the table to edit it here.
dev_items_fx_primary_hint: Primary stat buffs (food buffs, D-472) aren't read by combat yet; the consumption runtime will use them.
dev_items_fx_exclusive_hint: Exclusive group (D-472, D-501): one effect per unit per group (e.g. food). The same effect keeps the higher value; a different effect replaces it after a confirm dialog. Automatic use switches only when better for the situation and never uses one when an equal or better one is active. The consumption runtime applies it.
dev_items_fx_usage_none: No items or skills use this effect.
dev_items_bulk_export_hint: Exports the world's {count} effective items (chosen category) as pack-shaped JSON or flat common-field CSV.
dev_items_bulk_import_hint: JSON (pack shape) or CSV, up to {rows} rows and {kib} KiB. Imports only go to staged changes until you apply.
dev_items_bulk_staged: Staged. Check results from the bar below show here by row.
dev_items_bulk_columns: CSV columns: id, category, subcategory, tier, startPrice, weight, stackMax, tradable, bound, enabled, name.ko, name.en, description.ko, description.en, tags (tags joined with |). Blank = keep, - = remove. Use JSON for equipment and effects. The old column name baseValue is read as startPrice.
dev_items_bulk_patch_hint: Applies only the filled fields to the picked items right away (the server patches current entries; start price ‰ rounds half up). Blank fields stay.
dev_items_bulk_err_too_many_rows: Too many rows (300 max; import in parts).
dev_items_bulk_err_not_entries: Not an object with an entries array (pack shape) or an array of items.
dev_items_bulk_err_bad_entry: Not an item (id, name, category, tier, startPrice, enabled).
dev_items_bulk_err_column_count: Cell count differs from the header
dev_items_bulk_err_missing_value: Required value missing for a new item
dev_items_pick: Pick an item from the list.
dev_items_new_hint: It is staged switched off. Fill in the fields, switch it on, then [Apply].
dev_items_new_id_invalid: Start with a lowercase letter; 2–48 lowercase letters, digits or _
dev_items_new_id_taken: This ID is taken (deleted IDs cannot be reused).
dev_items_conflict_title: Someone changed the same fields. Choose which value to keep for each.
dev_items_conflict_pending: Choose the conflicting fields first ({count} entries)
dev_items_revert_staged_note: [Apply] returns it to the pack value.
dev_items_delete_staged_note: [Apply] deletes it and retires the ID.
dev_items_band_undecided: Rules for this category are not decided yet. Only the definition is edited.
dev_items_confirm_revert: Stage returning {id} to the pack value?
dev_items_confirm_delete: Stage deleting {id}? Once applied, the ID cannot be reused.

dev_items_confirm_code_ref: This switches off, or changes the slot or attack fields of, items that code or scenarios use by ID: {ids}. Simulations and preview screens may change. Apply?

dev_items_enabled_hint: When off it is not used in the world (recipes and necessities stop too).
dev_items_category_locked: Change pack entries with a pack commit
dev_items_tags_empty: No tags yet. Create them under [Item classes].
dev_items_start_price_hint: [placeholder] Only the first market price when this item's market opens in a world. After that the market price is used
dev_items_world_price_none: No market price — the server market is not open yet (the start price becomes the first price)
dev_items_lot_hint: Market orders, prices and recipe amounts are per lot; storage and transport use base units (empty = 1)

ruins_lead: Cities destroyed by gardener waves remain as ruins. Whoever first builds a government hall on that local map becomes the owner and runs the restoration project.
ruins_not_ready: Ruins appear once the world (NPC society) is ready.
ruins_rule_owner: On an unowned ruin site (where the nearest city or ruin to the cell is that ruin), whoever starts building a government hall first becomes the owner.
ruins_rule_fund: The owner can fund at any time; once the owner opens fundraising, anyone can. When the goal is met, the city returns and its 1,000 shares are split by contribution.
ruins_rule_dictatorship: In a dictatorship the ruling family keeps a majority of the shares.
ruins_no_cyborg: Create a cyborg to take part in ruin restoration.
ruins_build_hint: Build a government hall at cell {x}, {y} to become the owner.
ruins_build_no_room: No free cells nearby for a government hall.
ruins_claimed: Started a government hall on ruin #{id}. You are now the owner. Funding opens once it is finished.
ruins_shares_title: Shares if the goal were met now
ruins_opened: Opened fundraising for ruin #{id}. Anyone can contribute now.
ruins_fund_closed: You can contribute once the owner opens fundraising.
ruins_fund_short: Not enough of this currency. Buy it with the base currency at the exchange, then contribute.
ruins_restored: Goal met. City #{id} has been restored.

ruins_err_unknown_ruin: No such ruin. It may already have been restored.
ruins_err_not_claimed: No owner yet. Build a government hall first.

ruins_err_not_open: Fundraising is not open. Only the owner can contribute.
ruins_err_no_faction: There is no nation for the city to join.
ruins_err_timeout: No reply in time. Check the list again.
ruins_rule_hall: The government hall must be finished before funding opens. If it drops to 0% or disappears, whoever rebuilds it becomes the owner, and contributions stay in the project.
ruins_rule_goal: The goal scales with the old city's housing. When the deadline passes, every contribution is refunded and the ruin becomes ownerless again.
ruins_rule_level: A restored city's admin level is its government hall's level (up to Lv{max}).
ruins_hall_building: The government hall is under construction. Funding opens once it is finished.
ruins_hall_down: The government hall is at 0% or gone. Whoever rebuilds it becomes the owner.

ruins_fund_not_built: You can contribute once the government hall is finished.
ruins_fund_expired: The funding deadline has passed. Contributions are refunded at the end of the day.
ruins_dev_finish_done: The government hall is finished. Funding can open now.
